digest.component_or_area: store marker management and ensure registry
propositions: Committed */.archived and */.write.lock marker files dirty git status and break strict head checks because gitignore never un-tracks already-tracked files, even after ignore patterns were added.
An ensure unit must un-track runtime markers from the tickets branch via git rm --cached with a single commit, leaving worktree copies intact so local cache behavior is unchanged.
The reader must self-heal missing .archived markers by re-materializing them when compiled state indicates archived but the marker file is absent, restoring the fast-path cache on peers after merge.
Peers merging the untrack commit have their worktree marker files deleted by git during merge (tracked-unmodified file deletion) and status becomes clean without manual intervention.
